name: setup-keleres-flavor-tech
description: Keleres setup (pbd75@23, Bot Eta drafted Keleres, the after-draft flavour prompt setupStep5_<uid>_keleres<m|x|a>_null_<pos>_<yes|no>): the setup.keleres_flavor answer (Mentak, seat2 on the fork) sets the seat up as keleresm, and the Get Keleres Technology Options prompt it posts (FFCC_keleresm_getKeleresTechOptions, setup.keleres_tech) must be the Keleres seat's own (target = that seat, scope player). Before the fix it was captured with target null (posted while the faction was being set: the owner prefix named nobody yet) and nobody was asked, so web/e2e/setup-flow.mjs never answered it.
